reactions.description: Dehydrogenation of meroterpenoid precursor before cyclization in the anditomin biosynthetic pathway.
Conversion of preandiloid B yielding the enone preandiloid C.
Structural rearrangement generating a bicyclo[2.2.2]octane core in the anditomin biosynthetic pathway.
Conversion of preandiloid C to andiconin.
